entities.summary: Tanaga Island is an island in the western Andreanof Islands, in the southwest part of the Aleutian Islands, Alaska. The island has a land area of 204 square miles, making it the 33rd largest oceanic island in the United States. Its highest point is volcano Mount Tanaga at 5,925 feet.
